response.sql: WITH rating_rentals AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rentals FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_averages AS (SELECT AVG(rentals) AS overall_avg FROM rating_rentals), above_average AS (SELECT rr.rentals, ra.overall_avg FROM rating_rentals rr CROSS JOIN rating_averages ra WHERE rr.rentals > ra.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(rentals) AS average_rentals, AVG(rentals - overall_avg) AS average_above_overall FROM above_average
